spans.s:
r. 1st cl. (तर्पति) 4th cl. (ञि, उ) ञितृपु (तृप्यति) 5th cl. (तृप्नोति) 6th cl. (तृपति) and 10th cl. (तर्पयति)
1 To please, to satisfy, to content.
2 To be pleased or satisfied, to be content or satiate.
3 (In the 1st and 10th cls.) To light or kindle.

m. (-पत्)
1 The moon.
2 A parasol.
E.
तृप to please, अति Uṇādi affix, deriv. irr.

f. (-ला)
A creeper or creeping plant.
E.
तृप to please, कल Uṇādi aff.

mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं)
Contented, satisfied.
E.
तृप to be pleased, affix क्त.

mfn. (-त्मा-त्मा-त्म्)
Contented, satisfied, tranquil.
E.
तृप्त, and आत्मन् self.

f. (-प्तिः)
Satisfaction, content.
E.
तृप to please, or be pleased, affix क्तिन्.

m. (-प्रः)
Ghee or oiled butter.
E.
तृप to satisfy, Uṇādi affix रक्.

mfn. (-लुः-लुः-लु)
Having ghree, but not liking it or not blending with it.
E.
तृप, and आलुच् possessive affix; but in this compound implying also aversion.
